task: Reconcile diverse observational methods to deliver a consistent and high-confidence assessment of global glacial mass change (2000-2023)
primary_outputs: Regional and global glacial mass change time series at annual resolution
Expressed as specific mass change (m w.e.) and total mass change (Gt)
Method comparison across glaciological, DEM differencing, altimetry, gravimetry, and hybrid methods
data_source: GlaMBIE dataset (233 regional estimates, 35 research teams, ~450 contributors)
figures_required: Data overview (input dataset counts by region and method)
Global mass change time series with uncertainties
